title: chart anatomy title insight table
name: Chart anatomy title insight table — NSW
rule: Required anatomy: title (timeframe + unit) + insight summary + data table. Subtitle or callout, not both. Summary states what the data means (“requests rose from 220 to 420”), not “the line goes up.” Small datasets: full semantic table visible, not behind a toggle. Medium: summarised table. Large: summary + download of source.
pass_when: Title includes timeframe + unit; insight says what the data means; small sets show a visible semantic table; subtitle and callout are not both used.
fail_when: No table for a small set (or table only behind a toggle); summary is “the line goes up”; title omits unit/timeframe.
overview: Charts need title with timeframe and unit, insight summary, and data table.
apply_when: Publishing charts that need scannable anatomy and accessible data.
not_when: Missing tables for small sets, vague summaries, or titles without unit or timeframe.
agent_hint: Require timeframe-plus-unit title, meaningful insight, and a visible table for small sets.
description: Required anatomy: title with timeframe and unit, insight summary stating what the data means, and a data table. Use subtitle or callout, not both. Small datasets show a full semantic table visible, not behind a toggle. Pass when those hold. Fail when there is no table for a small set (or only behind a toggle), the summary is “the line goes up,” or the title omits unit or timeframe.
do_not_claim: Tooltip-only values as this anatomy row.
